This recommendation is NOT an automatic execution -- it requires separate human authorization.
verdict_reasoning: P2 calibration completed with a genuine, disclosed, non-manufactured result (19/19 eligible members resolved, real 41/50 requests consumed). P3B calibration binding replaced the sole calibration-dependent placeholder (the 3600s threshold) with measured validation rather than a new invented number. P3A historical classification advanced from 3-of-5 to 4-of-5 measured categories. RPC savings models were computed from real, calibration-grounded ratios rather than the overnight session's pre-calibration placeholder range. 56-launch family and canonical-attribution authority are explicitly preserved unweakened. All work this sprint was provider-free except the human's own manual resume executions, which were reconciled directly from durable ledger state at every step, never assumed from shell output.
